annotations.title: Discover datasets and sibling research tools

description: Discover which published datasets and sibling-product tools can answer a research question. Choose this for catalog discovery and handoff links, not for market observations: use world_markets_context for a market overview or market_workbench for supported FX and China histories. Explore the Palimpsest dataset catalog by topic, with source clocks, rights, freshness and pagination. Includes Seiche's separately completed funding context and explicit research steps into institution filings, exit liquidity and NarcoScope's granular global data. Source metadata and funding interpretations stay distinct. May fetch the published catalog; does not retrieve underlying dataset values or call the suggested sibling tools. No source collection, score changes, causal joins or trading authority.

limit.description: Maximum dataset metadata entries per page; suggested research steps are separate from this page size.

offset.description: Zero-based offset within the filtered catalog. Use the returned next_offset while keeping topic and limit unchanged.

topic.description: Research topic used to filter dataset metadata and select suggested sibling-product tools. This does not query those tools or retrieve dataset values.

name: research_network

outputSchema.description: Paginated source catalog and separate completed funding context.
